topic: Lateral stability: forces and Moments, effect of wing dihedral, effects of slide slip, induced roll and induced yaw.
syllabus_extract: Lateral stability: forces and Moments, effect of wing dihedral, effects of slide slip, induced roll and induced yaw. Factors effecting lateral stability. Wing sweepback effect. Dihedral effect
specific_objectives: 11.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to describe aircraft stability in all the three axis

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Diagrammatic representation of Dihedral effect and Sideslip forces on whiteboard; Safety: Ensure clear view; Supervision: Instructor monitors diagram accuracy.
intro_questions: Define lateral stability in simple terms.
List the three axes of aircraft motion.
What is the primary restoring force in lateral stability?

development.content:
Definition of lateral stability
Forces and moments involved
Effect of wing dihedral
Wing sweepback influence

Effects of sideslip on stability
Induced roll mechanism
Induced yaw mechanism
Factors affecting lateral stability

Summary of lateral stability concepts
Comparison of dihedral and sweepback
Real-world application examples

summary_questions: Explain how wing dihedral contributes to lateral stability.
Describe the relationship between sideslip and induced roll.
Identify two factors that affect lateral stability.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how lateral dynamic stability differs from static lateral stability, referencing concepts from LP 25.

pft_rows.syllabus: Longitudinal dynamic stability, lateral dynamic stability. Directional static stability, prop effects, damping in Yaw, directional control, Effect of wing sweep back, spin, lateral dynamic stability.
